::: {#exm-deviance}

#### The deviance of the six-patient trial

For the fit of @exm-logistic-regression, R's `glm` reports the deviance.
We check it against @eq-deviance computed by hand.

```{r}
#| code-fold: false
# fitted probabilities of recovery
wf_p <- fitted(wf_fit)
# minus twice the log-likelihood, from the formula
wf_dev_hand <- -2 * sum(wf_y * log(wf_p) + (1 - wf_y) * log(1 - wf_p))
# the deviance that glm reports
wf_dev_glm <- deviance(wf_fit)
c(by_hand = wf_dev_hand, glm = wf_dev_glm)
```

Both give $D = `r round(wf_dev_glm, 3)`$.

:::
